dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're an outlander as well?

dialogues.speaker: Nathan
dialogues.text: I'm from Mondstadt. My travels brought me to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Nathan
dialogues.text: I've witnessed the tyranny of the Shogunate and the sufferings of its people. Such things would have never been condoned in my hometown, Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Nathan
dialogues.text: That's why I joined up with the Sangonomiya resistance and pledged to fight for freedom.

dialogues.speaker: Nathan
dialogues.text: I never thought that the resistance, which was disadvantaged in every way, could actually bring the Shogunate to the negotiating table, and even abolish the Vision Hunt Decree. Now that's a cause for celebration!

dialogues.speaker: Nathan
dialogues.text: I guess that's the power of freedom for you, haha!
